companyDescription: Lunar Infrastructure + National Security Space · Nova-C/Nova-D landers ($1.1B+ NASA CLPS backlog) plus a new defense-spacecraft line (IM-300 platform) after the Aug 4, 2026 L3Harris/Space Development Agency missile-tracking subcontract — real diversification beyond the lunar-only thesis
priceNote: $16.57, up sharply from the $15.14 level of the last report — the bulk of the move came from the Aug 4, 2026 L3Harris/SDA missile-defense subcontract announcement (which drove a same-day pop as large as +22.8%), with the stock now consolidating near those post-news levels ahead of confirmed Q2 earnings on Aug 13.
marketCap: ~$3.6B (est. — ATM issuance ongoing, share count in flux)
sector: Space / Lunar Infrastructure + National Security Space
summary: Since the last report, Intuitive Machines picked up real business diversification: L3Harris selected it (Aug 4, 2026) to design, build, and deliver 18 IM-300 spacecraft platforms as a subcontractor on the Space Development Agency's $843M Tranche 3 missile-tracking program — a genuine move beyond the lunar-only thesis into national-security space, and the stock popped as much as +22.8% on the news. Q2 2026 earnings are now confirmed for Aug 13, 2026 (vs. an unconfirmed estimate last report). The lunar side is unchanged: IM-3 (targeting Reiner Gamma) still hasn't launched, and the $500M ATM equity program from June remains a live dilution overhang. This upgrades the thesis from 'pure binary IM-3 bet' to 'diversifying space platform with two live catalysts,' but doesn't remove the speculative risk.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Now confirmed for Aug 13, 2026 before market open (announced Jul 28) — upgraded from an unconfirmed estimate last report. Key reads: revenue trajectory off Q1's $186.7M, ATM pace/dilution commentary, and initial guidance on the new L3Harris/SDA defense-spacecraft revenue stream.

catalysts.name: L3Harris / SDA Missile-Defense Subcontract
catalysts.description: Aug 4, 2026: L3Harris selected Intuitive Machines to design, build and deliver 18 IM-300 spacecraft platforms supporting hypersonic/ballistic missile-tracking for the Space Development Agency's Tranche 3 program ($843M prime contract to L3Harris; IM's specific subcontract value undisclosed). Real diversification into national-security space beyond lunar landers.

catalysts.name: IM-3 Lunar Mission — Reiner Gamma
catalysts.description: Third Nova-C lander mission — still has NOT launched as of Aug 10. Redundant altimeters + lighting-independent navigation sensors target the upright-landing failures that hit IM-1 and IM-2. NASA/company guidance remains second half 2026, no confirmed exact date.

risks: $500M at-the-market equity program (launched Jun 2, 2026) remains an ongoing dilution overhang — not resolved by the L3Harris news, and will keep pressuring shares until the program is exhausted or capped
Track record: IM-1 tipped on landing (Feb 2024), IM-2 landed on its side with limited data transmission (Mar 2025) — IM-3's upright landing is not guaranteed despite hardware fixes
The L3Harris/SDA subcontract's specific dollar value to Intuitive Machines was not disclosed — the revenue/margin contribution is a real unknown until Q2 guidance or a follow-up filing clarifies it
Still lost the NASA Lunar Terrain Vehicle award to Astrolab/Lunar Outpost in May 2026 — no longer positioned as a multi-program Artemis mobility prime, even with the new defense-spacecraft line
Customer/NASA and DoD budget concentration — Congressional funding risk touches both the CLPS lunar backlog and the new SDA-linked defense revenue

estimateDates.note: Confirmed date — watch ATM pace, L3Harris/SDA revenue guidance, and IM-3 timeline update
Not yet launched — third Nova-C delivery, upright landing is the key open question

analystTargets.note: Carried from prior coverage; implies well over 100% upside from current level
Reiterated Buy through the prior decline

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026, with 3 of 12 officials dissenting toward a hike. Government contract-backed revenue (both NASA CLPS and the new SDA-linked defense line) is largely insulated from rate changes.
macroRisk.inflationNote: NASA/DoD contracts are cost-plus in parts — inflation pass-through partially protects margins on both revenue lines.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Space infrastructure with government contracts is rate-insensitive. NASA/DoD budget stability and LUNR's own ATM issuance pace are bigger watchpoints than Fed policy.
macroRisk.summary: LOW macro risk from a Fed perspective — the $1.1B+ NASA backlog plus the new L3Harris/SDA subcontract are a revenue floor largely independent of rates. The dominant risks here are company-specific (dilution, IM-3 execution, undisclosed subcontract economics), not macro.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — real defense-sector diversification (L3Harris/SDA missile-tracking subcontract, Aug 4) plus a now-confirmed Aug 13 earnings date reduce the pure-binary risk that dominated the last report, but the ATM dilution overhang and IM-3's unproven landing remain live. Scale in; don't chase the post-L3Harris pop into earnings.

catalystSpot.preRunup: LUNR has historically run 20-30% in the weeks before a confirmed lunar mission launch window, but the bigger recent driver was the Aug 4 contract-win announcement itself rather than a slow pre-catalyst build.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Contract-win news moves the stock same-day; lunar-mission run-ups build over 4-8 weeks pre-launch
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +15% to +30% pre-launch (lunar); the L3Harris contract news itself was worth up to +22.8% same-day

postWin.note: The Aug 4, 2026 L3Harris/SDA missile-defense subcontract announcement drove a same-day pop as large as +22.8% — the largest and most recent comparable for what real contract-diversification news does to this stock. IM-1 (first private Moon landing, Feb 2024) drove +45% in 3 days.

postLose.note: The Jun 2, 2026 ATM announcement triggered persistent selling (part of a 7-day, -24.5% losing streak) — a genuine, still-unresolved dilution overhang. A failed IM-3 landing or earnings miss on Aug 13 could compound this.

spotSizing.reason: Real diversification (L3Harris/SDA) offsets some of the prior negative catalysts (LTV loss, ATM dilution), but the dilution overhang and IM-3 binary risk are both still live — max 5% of portfolio, speculative sizing.

stopPreCatalyst.note: A break below ~$13.26 ahead of Aug 13 earnings would suggest the L3Harris-driven rally is fully reversing

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Aug 13 earnings miss with a guidance cut, or IM-3 later fails to land upright, exit 50%+ immediately
